episodes.title: What Happens If You Go To Epstein Island Now?
episodes.description:
Videos across YouTube have popped up showing influencers and conspiracy theorists sneaking onto the island once owned by sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. One YouTuber, Andrew Petersen of “SideQuest Drew,” told Business Insider he went to seek the truth about the island once owned by the famous pedophile. But things didn't go as planned.

Read "How Jeffrey Epstein's island became a nightmare for influencers": https://bit.ly/4pT7YeR
